findings.scope: Only formal openings, rebuttals, cross-examinations and closings supply evaluation. Q&A, logistics and outro supply no credit, penalty or absence inference. Corrected Suetonius question uses events 2973–2980 with surrounding Ehrman words contextual.
findings.sourceAndBurden: Read all 32 cards and overall items against the locked source restrictions and resolved limitations. Preserved printed-edition denominator, P75 shared ancestry without direct copying, hypothetical bottleneck, conjectural rather than proved loss, local-versus-book Hebrews contrast, later Mark nuance, personal inspiration and limited apostolic concession. Conditional burdens distinguish rebuttal from affirmative proof. Universal historical-Bibles wording retains its actual inferential limitation. White’s convergence answer is unresolved, not absent.
findings.completeQuotes: Both exact eligible spans are complete assertions: all Bibles misquote Jesus; textual variants are not misquotations. Adjacent closing context preserves historical manuscripts for Ehrman and collective recovery/message for White. Context identifies scope without finishing a proposition.
findings.scoreConsistency: All 32 move scores, sections, 88–86 totals, strengths and blunders match the locked ledger. No judgment, score or inventory change.
findings.nonformulaicCritiques: Every four-label critique discusses its actual evidence, inference, limitation and burden. No threshold common six-word boilerplate. Explanatory restatements preserve relevant local/general distinctions rather than interchangeable praise.
findings.aiDistinctness: Both sides reviewed together: qualification duties under uncertainty differ from orthodox invented speech with false provenance; critical notes change publication assertions, while a translation thought experiment grounds semantic fidelity. Four distinct added inferences, no new empirical evidence, no equation of doubt with demonstrated misquotation.
findings.aiProseAndPunctuation: Direct philosophical prose, distinct openings and progression, natural punctuation, no interchangeable scaffolds or creative-operation announcements. Independent 25-debate comparison used for style only.
